brief: Two instrument lies. (1) filmstrip.mjs's POP gate compares a 0.35 s-gap whole-frame Δ against a fixed 2 and so reads a legitimately fast winter dusk (daylight moves 0.04/sample, ~7 RGB) as a pop — it cost #48 a whole iteration on a false premise. Make a pop a sample far above its NEIGHBOURS (a step), not a sample far above 2, and print the per-60fps-frame rate beside it; keep HEAD's existing POP count at summer noon at 0 and winter dusk should now read 0 on HEAD. (2) run-loop.sh's MANAGER_GAP check reads last_manager=-99 on a fresh start, so the stall check runs before the first landed iteration regardless of the gap; make a first-run baseline of the current iteration.
successLooksLike: filmstrip on HEAD at winter dusk reports 0 POP where it reported 1 with a 7.0 Δ; a synthetic one-frame step of 10 RGB injected via a probe still reads as POP. run-loop.sh dry-run shows the manager gap honoured from the first iteration.
avoid: Do not loosen the FROZEN gate. Do not touch courtyard.html — a Harness brief grades on commit+log.
